reading.title: Can robots care?
reading.text: Robots are now capable of lifting patients, reminding them to take medicine and even holding simple conversations. In Japan, where hospitals often operate at full capacity, care robots are widely accepted. In Europe, however, public perception is more negative: many people find the concept of a machine looking after their grandparents disturbing. Experts say robots should support nurses, not replace them, except perhaps in the most repetitive tasks.
